::: {.reference-list}
1. IRI. *PyCPT 2.10.4 source: `pycpt/src/pycpt/notebook.py`* (`setup`, `download_data`, `summarize_available_years`, `evaluate_models` and the plotting functions). Tag pycpt-2.10.4, commit 084bb5c. <https://github.com/iri-pycpt/pycpt/blob/084bb5c380c200b5f65f11ba224a965547b91da1/pycpt/src/pycpt/notebook.py>
2. IRI. *PyCPT 2.10.4 source: `cptdl`* (data catalog, `leads_from_target`, `evaluate_url`, `download`, `simple_download`). Tag pycpt-2.10.4, commit 084bb5c. <https://github.com/iri-pycpt/pycpt/tree/084bb5c380c200b5f65f11ba224a965547b91da1/pycpt/src/cptdl>
3. PyCPT Tutorial. *Audit of the Indonesia experiments against CPT references* (research/reports/METHODOLOGY_AUDIT.md). <https://github.com/bennyistanto/pycpt-tutorial/blob/main/research/reports/METHODOLOGY_AUDIT.md>
4. IRI Data Library. *NMME NCEP-CFSv2 hindcasts, PENTAD_SAMPLES_FULL, precipitation*. <https://iridl.ldeo.columbia.edu/SOURCES/.Models/.NMME/.NCEP-CFSv2/.HINDCAST/.PENTAD_SAMPLES_FULL/.prec/> Browsing Data Library pages requires signing in (checked 10 November 2026); PyCPT's data requests in this tutorial succeeded without a key.
5. Saha, S., Moorthi, S., Wu, X., et al. (2014). The NCEP Climate Forecast System Version 2. *Journal of Climate*, 27(6), 2185-2208. <https://doi.org/10.1175/JCLI-D-12-00823.1>
6. Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara. *CHIRPS: Rainfall Estimates from Rain Gauge and Satellite Observations* (CHIRPS version 3.0 page). <https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps3>
7. Funk, C., Peterson, P., Landsfeld, M., et al. (2014). *A quasi-global precipitation time series for drought monitoring*. U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 832. <https://doi.org/10.3133/ds832>
8. Natural Earth. *Admin 0: Countries*, 1:10m cultural vectors. <https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-admin-0-countries/>
9. Shapely. *shapely.contains_xy*. <https://shapely.readthedocs.io/en/stable/reference/shapely.contains_xy.html>
10. NumPy. *numpy.quantile* (NumPy manual). <https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.quantile.html>
11. Mason, S. J., and Weigel, A. P. (2009). A generic forecast verification framework for administrative purposes. *Monthly Weather Review*, 137(1), 331-349. <https://doi.org/10.1175/2008MWR2553.1>
12. Epstein, E. S. (1969). A scoring system for probability forecasts of ranked categories. *Journal of Applied Meteorology*, 8(6), 985-987. <https://doi.org/10.1175/1520-0450(1969)008%3C0985:ASSFPF%3E2.0.CO;2>
13. Barnston, A. G., and van den Dool, H. M. (1993). A degeneracy in cross-validated skill in regression-based forecasts. *Journal of Climate*, 6(5), 963-977. <https://doi.org/10.1175/1520-0442(1993)006%3C0963:ADICVS%3E2.0.CO;2>
14. SciTools. *Cartopy* (documentation). <https://scitools.org.uk/cartopy/docs/latest/>
:::
